Agent (Vusi Pretorius): Hi Jennifer Martinez, Vusi Pretorius here — let me pull that up.
Customer (Jennifer Martinez): I already explained this on my last contact.
Agent (Vusi Pretorius): I'm sorry about that — let me look at what happened last time and pick up from there.
Customer (Jennifer Martinez): The website said free returns, but you're telling me you're deducting a restocking fee from my refund.
Agent (Vusi Pretorius): I hear you, and I want to get this sorted out rather than just tell you what the policy says.
Agent (Vusi Pretorius): Can you confirm the email or order number on the account so I'm looking at the right one?
Customer (Jennifer Martinez): Yes, that's correct.
Customer (Jennifer Martinez): I already printed the label myself and dropped it off, so I don't understand what the holdup is.
Agent (Vusi Pretorius): Let me check — pulled up the return authorization and checked the refund processing queue against the carrier scan.
Agent (Vusi Pretorius): Alright, I can see exactly what's going on here.
Agent (Vusi Pretorius): explained that the return shipping fee applies once the item is outside the original free-return window, with no exception available on this order
Customer (Jennifer Martinez): That's not really the answer I was hoping for, but okay.
Agent (Vusi Pretorius): I've logged everything here so if this comes up again, the next agent has the full picture.
